name: Advances in Finishing of Textiles
description: This course provides an in-depth understanding of the sustainability challenges facing the finishing industry and conventional and advanced textile finishing techniques. Water and energy saving technologies, mechanical and chemical finishes including calendaring, raising and emerising, easy care, antimicrobial, flame retardant, UV resistant, water resistant and softeners are covered. Emerging technologies such as dry finishing using plasma and other surface functionalisation techniques, tuneable and biomimetic finishes and nanotechnology-based finishes are discussed.
